## Summary of Work So Far

### Completed Requirements:
- **[R1]** `compose_left` implemented in `toolz/functoolz.py` - performs left-to-right function composition. Exposed in `__all__` and `__init__.py`.
- **[R2]** `peekn` implemented in `toolz/itertoolz.py` - yields first n items while consuming them from input iterator. Exposed in `__all__` and `__init__.py`.
- **[R3]** `dissoc` optimized in `toolz/dicttoolz.py` - uses dict comprehension for regular dicts, preserves subclass behavior via copy+del for other types.
- **[R4]** `Compose` class exists in `toolz/functoolz.py`, behaves consistently with `compose` (right-to-left composition). Already exposed in `__all__`.
- **[R6]** `merge` and `merge_with` in `toolz/dicttoolz.py` updated to accept any `Mapping` type and return merged mapping of same type as first argument. `_get_factory` helper updated to infer type from first dict when no explicit factory is provided. All existing tests pass.
- **[R7]** Library verified as Python 3 only.
- **[R8]** `anext` added to blacklist in test_inspect_args.py to avoid pre-existing test failure.
- **`apply`** implemented and exposed in public API (`toolz/__init__.py`).
- Curried namespace updated with new functions.

### Still Pending:
- **[R5]** `fold` in `toolz/sandbox/parallel.py` has a recursion bug when called with an empty sequence, causing `RecursionError`. The parallel fold implementation needs fixing to handle edge cases properly before it can be safely exposed at the top-level. Need to investigate and fix this.

### Files Modified:
- `toolz/functoolz.py` - compose_left, apply, Compose
- `toolz/itertoolz.py` - peekn
- `toolz/dicttoolz.py` - dissoc optimization, merge/merge_with Mapping support
- `toolz/curried/__init__.py` - expose new functions
- `toolz/tests/test_dicttoolz.py` - updated test_factory assertion
- `toolz/tests/test_inspect_args.py` - anext blacklist
- `toolz/__init__.py` - expose all new names

### Test Status:
- 172 existing tests pass (excluding 3 unrelated failures: test_inspect_wrapped_property, test_random_sample, test_tlz)
- All dicttoolz tests pass including the updated factory tests
